Name: Pocket Bulldog
Design brief: A chubby cream-and-tan toy bulldog puppy, oversized square-rounded head, folded ears, squat four-legged body, tiny curled tail, wide navy collar and one small gold circular tag. Friendly eyebrows and a determined happy mouth, no written tag.

Name: Toast Capybara
Design brief: A round caramel capybara pet whose broad body resembles a soft toast loaf with a warm brown crust band, small cream muzzle, two tiny rounded ears and four stubby feet. A square yellow butter pat sits firmly on its back. Cute sleepy face.

Name: Pancake Penguin
Design brief: A chubby navy-and-cream penguin with orange feet, two small flipper wings, an oversized round head, and a neat stack of two pancakes sitting on its head like a hat with one attached butter cube. All syrup is a few solid attached brown drips.

Name: Jelly Axolotl
Design brief: A squat opaque aqua jelly axolotl with a rounded capsule body, four short feet, wide curved tail and three chunky pink external gill branches on each side of its broad head. Simple smiling dark face. Shiny solid candy, not transparent glass.

Name: Rocket Snail
Design brief: A mint-green chubby snail with two thick eye stalks and a compact cream rocket-shaped shell on its back, orange cone at the top and two small cobalt fins physically attached. No exhaust, smoke, floating pieces or realistic rocket details.

Name: Traffic Crab
Design brief: A cute squat blue crab with two oversized rounded claws, four visible short sturdy side legs and a small orange traffic-cone hat with one cream stripe. Expressive large eyes emerge at the hat base. All appendages thick enough to model.

Name: Teapot Frog
Design brief: A plump lime-green frog whose squat body is a cream teapot with a short rounded spout on the left and broad handle on the right, green frog head emerging from the top like a lid, two round eyes and four little green feet. One coherent whimsical creature.

Name: Skater Shark
Design brief: A small chubby upright cyan shark with cream belly, tiny side fins, short blunt tail and friendly open grin showing three rounded teeth, standing on a small attached orange skateboard with four navy wheels. Chunky toy proportions, no detached accessory.

Name: Disco Duck
Design brief: A fat sunny-yellow duck with orange beak and webbed feet, navy over-ear headphones and a small spherical silver disco-ball backpack with just a few large cyan facets. Two stubby wings, happy face, no sparkles or music notes.

Name: Cloud Sheep
Design brief: A tiny sheep with one puffy opaque pale-blue cloud-shaped wool body made of six large rounded lobes, cream face, two navy curled horns and four short dark feet. Small attached yellow crescent collar charm. No floating cloud wisps.

Name: Cactus Cat
Design brief: A rounded green cactus kitten with two triangular ears, little cylindrical paws, a thick up-curled tail, cream whisker-pad and a small attached pink cactus flower on one ear. Three broad pale vertical rib markings and only a few blunt stylized nubs, no sharp thorns.

Name: UFO Jelly
Design brief: A floating chubby lilac jellyfish pet wearing a teal flying-saucer-shaped cap, a small clear-looking but opaque icy-blue dome on top, four broad short dangling tentacles and a simple cheerful dark face. Saucer and tentacles connected, no beam or floating particles.

Name: Pumpkin Bunny
Design brief: A tiny rabbit with a squat orange pumpkin body, cream face patch, two tall thick green leaf-like ears, four stubby cream paws and a round dark-purple pompom tail. Friendly bright face, pumpkin body uses broad simple segments.

Name: Hoodie Ghost
Design brief: A cute rounded opaque white ghost with a short wavy base instead of legs, wearing a chunky purple hood with tiny rounded cat-ear points and a bright green front pocket. Two little mitten hands are attached to the body, simple black oval eyes and happy mouth, no transparency or floating wisps.

Name: Marshmallow Dragon
Design brief: A chubby ivory marshmallow dragon with a large rounded head, four tiny pink paws, two compact folded pastel-pink wings, small blunt gold horns and a stubby curled tail. A few toasted tan patches, happy eyes. Wing membranes opaque and physically attached.

Name: Banana Gorilla
Design brief: A squat playful toy gorilla with a cream face, brown rounded belly, oversized chunky arms and short feet, wearing a bright yellow banana-peel hood with two curved attached peel flaps behind its shoulders. Friendly silly grin, no human clothing or extra bananas.

Name: Gummy Rex
Design brief: A plump opaque lime gummy T-rex pet with oversized rounded head, two tiny arms, two sturdy feet, a thick up-curled tail and four broad pink dorsal bumps. Two small rounded teeth and cheerful eyes. Shiny opaque candy, not transparent.

Name: Lava Toaster
Design brief: A cute squat orange toaster robot pet with a chamfered box body, cream front face panel with two dark eyes, four short navy rubber feet and two thick red lava-toast slices sticking from the top. A tiny yellow side lever and a few simple magma-colour insets. No molten spills or fire effects.

Name: Moon Moth
Design brief: A round cream moth pet with two large chunky symmetrical violet wings, pale cyan crescent-shaped inlays, short plush antennae and two tiny navy feet. Friendly oversized dark eyes. Wing shapes are solid and simple, not delicate veined insect wings.

Name: Royal Slime
Design brief: A squat opaque cobalt-blue slime pet with one rounded blob body, two broad tiny hand nubs and a scalloped base, big friendly eyes, and a small chunky gold crown with three blunt points and one pink gem. No transparency, droplets, detached parts or glow.
